mapper.select: SELECT sr.role_code FROM sys_role sr INNER JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sr.id = sur.role_id WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId} AND sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT sp.permission_code FROM sys_permission sp INNER JOIN sys_role_permission srp ON sp.id = srp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role sur ON srp.role_id = sur.role_id WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.status = 1
